candidates.text: ALSO PURSUANT TO RULE 42 AND REMIND ALL IN THIS CHAMBER THAT NO DEMONSTRATION OF APPROVAL OR DISAPPROVAL FROM MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE PERMITTED.
FOLLOWING AN ELECTION WE PRAY OUR VOTER WHO ART IN HEAVEN THY WILL BE DONE.
AT THIS MOMENT I WOULD LIKE TO HONOR UM BOSTON BY FOOT DAY, UM ,WITH A RESOLUTION ON BEHALF OF THE ENTIRE BOSTON CITY COUNCIL.
WE ARE ASKING THAT YOU ATTEND THAT HEARING AND PASS THIS ORDINANCE.
WE'RE NOW ON TO THE FIRST ORDER OF BUSINESS, WHICH IS THE APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES FROM THE MEETING OF OCTOBER 28TH, 2026.
THE MINUTES OF OCTOBER 28TH MEETING ARE APPROVED.
TALKING NUMBER 2087 AS RECEIVED 12 VOTES IN THE AFFIRMATIVE.
ALL IN FAVOR SAY AYE ON OPPOSED.
SO I CAN HAVE A2088 AS RECEIVED 12 VOTES IN THE AFFIRMATIVE.
UM, COUNCILOR FLYNN SIX SUSPENSION OF THE RULES AND PASSAGE OF DOCKET 2105.
